title: events.subscribe
description: Subscribes the connection to events for every pane in the session, as pane.list sees them. Needs hello version 2 and a caller with a controlling terminal. One subscription per connection; a second is refused. After the result the core sends notifications, {"jsonrpc": "2.0", "method": "event", "params": <event>}, with no id. A subscriber that lets 2 MiB of them queue unread is closed.

event.description: The params of a notification: pane numbers, status and exit status only, never screen contents or titles.

status.description: Not with pane.closed. As pane.list reports it, from OSC 133 marks that output can fake.

exit.description: Not with pane.closed. The last exit status the shell gave, or null.
